answer: To blunt a flood of fake agents, the market pins each newcomer to one lasting relic: a bond they must lock before speaking. The bond sits at a public vertex that maps key to stake, so cloning a thousand names still costs a thousand deposits. Peers refuse any voice whose key lacks that mark, and they slash the stake when the same key fans out across disposable aliases. A willow roster of stewards rotates the slash threshold each epoch, so fixed farms cannot pre-bake cheap keys. The defense fails only if bonds are refundable instantly or the vertex map can be forged.
